content: Cyrillic is broadly covered by mainstream web fonts and Google Fonts subsets, so 'tofu' boxes are unlikely with major fonts, but custom/decorative display fonts and icon fonts sold as Latin-only kits often lack Cyrillic glyphs. Use unicode-range in @font-face to scope custom fonts to Latin-only ranges and pair with a Cyrillic-complete fallback (e.g. Noto Sans) for the rest, or verify the chosen webfont explicitly ships a Cyrillic subset before adopting it as primary body font.
